mapper.insert: insert into admin_principals ( principal_id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{principal.principalId}, #{principal.username}, #{principal.passwordHash}, #{principal.displayName}, #{principal.status}, #{principal.createdAt}, #{principal.updatedAt} )
insert into admin_roles (role_code, description, created_at) values (#{roleCode}, #{description}, #{createdAt}) on conflict (role_code) do nothing
insert into admin_principal_roles (principal_id, role_code, granted_at) values (#{principalId}, #{roleCode}, #{grantedAt}) on conflict (principal_id, role_code) do nothing
mapper.select: select role_code from admin_principal_roles where principal_id = #{principalId} order by role_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into admin_refresh_tokens ( refresh_token_id, principal_id, status, issued_at, expires_at, updated_at, rotated_at, revoked_at, replacement_token_id ) values ( #{refreshToken.refreshTokenId}, #{refreshToken.principalId}, #{refreshToken.status}, #{refreshToken.issuedAt}, #{refreshToken.expiresAt}, #{refreshToken.updatedAt}, #{refreshToken.rotatedAt}, #{refreshToken.revokedAt}, #{refreshToken.replacementTokenId} )
mapper.select: select refresh_token_id, principal_id, status, issued_at, expires_at, updated_at, rotated_at, revoked_at, replacement_token_id from admin_refresh_tokens where refresh_token_id = #{refreshTokenId} for update
mapper.update: update admin_refresh_tokens set status = 'rotated', rotated_at = #{rotatedAt}, updated_at = #{rotatedAt}, replacement_token_id = #{replacementTokenId} where refresh_token_id = #{refreshTokenId} and status = 'active'
